name: CloudMoo Self-Hosted
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted multi-cloud infrastructure monitoring dashboard with scheduled asset status checks, 30-day uptime history, team access and email alerts; no software subscription or expiry stated.
watch_out: Requires self-provided compute, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ and provider API credentials; cloud resources and external SMTP delivery are not included. Configure read-only cloud credentials and review security before production use.
